{{TAG:000E:0001:}}{{TAG:0005:0013:0000}}, {{TAG:0003:0016:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}combinan

FR:
{{TAG:0003:0023:}}Aimes-tu les brocolis ?{{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}} Moi, je les

Pour tout te dire,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} j'en mets dans

{{TAG:0003:0022:}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}! {{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}It's freezing cold

{{TAG:0003:0022:}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}! {{TAG:0007:0000:10000000}}Fuori si congela,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
